description: The AWS account ID that incurred this line of usage.
The AWS service this cost line item belongs to, e.g. Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS.

Identifies the specific billing dimension within a service, combining a region prefix with a usage category, e.g. USE1-BoxUsage:t3.medium for EC2 compute-hours, or USE1-TimedStorage-ByteHrs for S3 storage. Two rows with the same Service can have different UsageType values because they are billed under different rate categories (compute vs. storage vs. data transfer).
The AWS region the usage occurred in, e.g. us-east-1.
The calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) this usage row applies to.
The amount of the resource consumed on this date, in the unit implied by UsageType (hours, GB, requests, etc.).
The actual cost billed for this usage row, in the currency given by Currency, before any Reserved Instance or Savings Plan blending is applied across the account.
The ISO currency code for UnblendedCost, e.g. USD.
